subject: Whether the Section 31 23 00 minimum cover requirement for the underground utility trench

messages.text: Does the Section 31 23 00 minimum cover requirement for the underground utility trench backfill shown on Civil Detail 2/C501 hold up against the geotechnical report's requirements for this area? We'd like this confirmed ahead of the next civil inspection. We don't anticipate any effect on the contract sum. This isn't holding up any current earthwork activity. Please respond within five days so we can schedule the civil inspection.
